nested_buy_details: WITH projected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT slot,transaction_index,record_ordinal,transaction_status,json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_nested_buy_analysis') AS diagnoses FROM bronze) SELECT b.slot,b.transaction_index,b.transaction_status,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.evaluated_profile') AS evaluated_profile,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.disposition') AS disposition,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.reason') AS reason,json_extract(d.value,'$.instruction_bytes') AS instruction_bytes,json_extract(d.value,'$.instruction.track_volume') AS track_volume,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.instruction.amount_raw_u64') AS amount_raw_u64,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.instruction.max_sol_cost_raw_u64') AS max_sol_cost_raw_u64,json_extract(d.value,'$.outer_index') AS outer_index,json_extract(d.value,'$.instruction_inner_order') AS instruction_inner_order,json_extract(d.value,'$.instruction_stack_height') AS instruction_stack_height,json_extract(d.value,'$.event_context.inner_order') AS event_inner_order,json_extract(d.value,'$.event_context.stack_height') AS event_stack_height,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.event_reported.mint_address') AS reported_mint,json_extract(d.value,'$.event_reported.mayhem_mode') AS event_mayhem_mode,json_extract(d.value,'$.account_address_correspondence') AS account_address_correspondence,json_extract(d.value,'$.mayhem_context.cpi_signer') AS actual_cpi_signer,json_extract(d.value,'$.proof_gaps') AS proof_gaps,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.source_evidence_sha256') AS source_evidence_sha256 FROM projected b,json_each(b.diagnoses) d WHERE d.key IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.record_ordinal,CAST(d.key AS BIGINT)
nested_buy_account_gaps: WITH projected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT slot,transaction_index,record_ordinal,json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_nested_buy_analysis') AS diagnoses FROM bronze), diagnoses AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT b.slot,b.transaction_index,b.record_ordinal,CAST(d.key AS BIGINT) AS diagnostic_order,json_extract(d.value,'$.accounts') AS accounts FROM projected b,json_each(b.diagnoses) d WHERE d.key IS NOT NULL) SELECT b.slot,b.transaction_index,json_extract(a.value,'$.position') AS account_position,json_extract_string(a.value,'$.role') AS pinned_expected_role,json_extract_string(a.value,'$.observed') AS observed,json_extract_string(a.value,'$.expected') AS expected,json_extract(a.value,'$.address_match') AS address_match,json_extract(a.value,'$.message_signer') AS message_signer,json_extract(a.value,'$.cpi_signer') AS actual_cpi_signer,json_extract_string(a.value,'$.actual_role_if_mismatched') AS unresolved_role FROM diagnoses b,json_each(b.accounts) a WHERE json_extract(a.value,'$.address_match') IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' OR json_extract(a.value,'$.message_minimum_privileges_match') IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' ORDER BY b.record_ordinal,b.diagnostic_order,CAST(a.key AS BIGINT)
slot_counts: SELECT slot, COUNT(*) AS present_envelopes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE disposition='DECODED') AS decoded, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE disposition='MISSING') AS missing, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE disposition='UNSUPPORTED') AS unsupported, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE disposition='QUARANTINED') AS quarantined, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_status='OK') AS status_ok, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_status='ERROR') AS status_error, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_status IS NULL) AS status_unknown, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pump_program_involvement IS TRUE) AS pump_positive, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pump_program_involvement IS FALSE) AS pump_negative, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pump_program_involvement IS NULL) AS pump_unknown FROM bronze GROUP BY slot ORDER BY slot
envelope_reasons: SELECT disposition, reason, COUNT(*) AS envelopes FROM bronze GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
program_frequencies: WITH projected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.program_ids') AS ids,json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.instructions') AS instructions,json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.inner_instructions') AS inner_instructions FROM bronze), source_references AS (SELECT json_extract_string(p.value,'$') AS program_id, 1 AS package_presence, 0 AS declared_top_level, 0 AS recorded_cpi FROM projected b,json_each(b.ids) p UNION ALL SELECT json_extract_string(i.value,'$.program_id'),0,1,0 FROM projected b,json_each(b.instructions) i UNION ALL SELECT json_extract_string(i.value,'$.program_id'),0,0,1 FROM projected b,json_each(b.inner_instructions) i WHERE i.type='OBJECT') SELECT program_id,SUM(package_presence) AS transaction_packages,SUM(declared_top_level) AS declared_top_level_references,SUM(recorded_cpi) AS recorded_cpi_references FROM source_references GROUP BY program_id ORDER BY program_id
program_coverage: SELECT COUNT(*) AS all_envelopes,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE disposition='DECODED') AS decoded_packages,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE disposition!='DECODED') AS undecoded_packages,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE disposition='DECODED' AND json_type(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.inner_instructions')='ARRAY') AS packages_with_recorded_cpi_inventory,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE disposition='DECODED' AND json_type(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.inner_instructions') IS DISTINCT FROM 'ARRAY') AS packages_with_unknown_cpi_inventory,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pump_program_involvement IS NULL) AS pump_involvement_unknown FROM bronze
slot_source_bindings: SELECT slot,raw_sha256,manifest_sha256,payload_manifest_sha256,COUNT(*) AS records FROM bronze GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
pump_packages: SELECT b.slot,b.transaction_index,b.transaction_status,b.record_sha256,b.raw_sha256,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver s WHERE s.bronze_record_sha256=b.record_sha256) AS recorded_sell_facts, json_array_length(json_extract(decode(b.record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_structural_analysis.observations')) AS structural_probes, json_extract_string(decode(b.record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_structural_analysis.cpi_coverage') AS cpi_coverage FROM bronze b WHERE b.pump_program_involvement IS TRUE ORDER BY b.record_ordinal
structural_probes: WITH projected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_structural_analysis.observations') AS observations FROM bronze) SELECT json_extract_string(p.value,'$.context.kind') AS context_kind,json_extract_string(p.value,'$.kind') AS probe_kind,json_extract_string(p.value,'$.layout_outcome') AS probe_outcome,json_extract_string(p.value,'$.layout_error.reason') AS reason,COUNT(*) AS probes FROM projected b,json_each(b.observations) p GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
sell_admissions: WITH projected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT slot,transaction_index,record_ordinal,json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_sell_analysis') AS admissions FROM bronze) SELECT b.slot,b.transaction_index,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.disposition') AS disposition,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.reason') AS reason,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.selected_candidate') AS candidate FROM projected b,json_each(b.admissions) d ORDER BY b.record_ordinal,CAST(d.key AS BIGINT)
sell_profile_details: WITH projected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT slot,transaction_index,record_ordinal,transaction_status,json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_sell_analysis') AS admissions FROM bronze) SELECT b.slot,b.transaction_index,b.transaction_status,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.evaluated_profile') AS evaluated_profile,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.selected_candidate') AS admitted_candidate,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.disposition') AS disposition,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.reason') AS reason,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.profile_evidence_status') AS profile_evidence_status,json_extract(d.value,'$.proof_gaps') AS proof_gaps,json_extract(d.value,'$.account_count') AS account_count,json_extract(d.value,'$.event_reported.mayhem_mode') AS mayhem_mode,json_extract(d.value,'$.outer_index') AS outer_index,json_extract(d.value,'$.instruction_inner_order') AS instruction_inner_order,json_extract(d.value,'$.event_context.inner_order') AS event_inner_order,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.instruction_sha256') AS instruction_sha256,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.event_context.event_cpi_sha256') AS event_cpi_sha256,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.source_evidence_sha256') AS source_evidence_sha256 FROM projected b,json_each(b.admissions) d ORDER BY b.record_ordinal,CAST(d.key AS BIGINT)
sell_account_evidence_gaps: WITH projected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT slot,transaction_index,record_ordinal,json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_sell_analysis') AS admissions FROM bronze), diagnoses AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT b.slot,b.transaction_index,b.record_ordinal,CAST(d.key AS BIGINT) AS diagnostic_order,json_extract(d.value,'$.accounts') AS accounts FROM projected b,json_each(b.admissions) d) SELECT b.slot,b.transaction_index,json_extract(a.value,'$.position') AS account_position,json_extract_string(a.value,'$.role') AS expected_account_role,json_extract_string(a.value,'$.observed') AS observed,json_extract_string(a.value,'$.expected') AS expected,json_extract(a.value,'$.address_match') AS address_match,json_extract(a.value,'$.message_signer') AS message_signer,json_extract(a.value,'$.message_minimum_privileges_match') AS message_minimum_privileges_match,json_extract(a.value,'$.cpi_signer') AS cpi_signer FROM diagnoses b,json_each(b.accounts) a WHERE json_extract(a.value,'$.address_match')='false' OR json_extract(a.value,'$.message_minimum_privileges_match')='false' OR json_extract(a.value,'$.required_privileges_match')='false' ORDER BY b.record_ordinal,b.diagnostic_order,CAST(a.key AS BIGINT)
missing_bronze_fields: SELECT disposition,status_metadata_bytes_state,observed_at_state,actionable_at_state,execution_opportunity_at_state,observation_model_id_state,name_state,ticker_state,launch_at_state,COUNT(*) AS records FROM bronze GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
silver_suitability: SELECT COUNT(*) AS facts,COUNT(DISTINCT bronze_record_sha256) AS parent_packages,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mint IS NOT NULL) AS mint_known,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amount_raw_u64 IS NOT NULL AND token_amount_raw_u64 IS NOT NULL AND sol_amount_raw_u64 IS NOT NULL) AS raw_quantities_known,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quote_decimals IS NOT NULL AND base_decimals IS NOT NULL AND quote_mint_identity!='UNKNOWN') AS economic_units_known,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE observation_model_id IS NOT NULL AND observed_at IS NOT NULL AND actionable_at IS NOT NULL) AS actionable_time_known,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE executable_price IS NOT NULL) AS executable_price_known FROM silver
duplicate_identity: SELECT slot,transaction_index,COUNT(*) AS records FROM bronze GROUP BY ALL HAVING COUNT(*)!=1 ORDER BY ALL
index_extents: SELECT slot,COUNT(transaction_index) AS known_indices,MIN(transaction_index) AS first_index,MAX(transaction_index) AS last_index FROM bronze GROUP BY slot ORDER BY slot
foreign_parent: SELECT s.record_sha256 FROM silver s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bronze b WHERE b.record_sha256=s.bronze_record_sha256 AND b.slot=s.slot AND b.transaction_index=s.transaction_index AND b.raw_sha256=s.raw_sha256) ORDER BY s.record_ordinal
buy_version_details: WITH projected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT slot,transaction_index,record_ordinal,transaction_status,json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_buy_variant_analysis') AS diagnoses FROM bronze) SELECT b.slot,b.transaction_index,b.transaction_status,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.evaluated_profile') AS evaluated_profile,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.disposition') AS disposition,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.reason') AS reason,json_extract(d.value,'$.instruction.bytes') AS instruction_bytes,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.instruction.discriminator_hex') AS discriminator_hex,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.instruction.amount_raw_u64') AS amount_raw_u64,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.instruction.max_sol_cost_raw_u64') AS max_sol_cost_raw_u64,json_extract(d.value,'$.instruction.track_volume') AS instruction_track_volume,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.instruction.track_volume_evidence') AS instruction_track_volume_evidence,json_extract(d.value,'$.event_reported.track_volume') AS event_track_volume,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.token_program') AS token_program,json_extract(d.value,'$.account_count') AS account_count,json_extract(d.value,'$.account_address_correspondence') AS account_address_correspondence,json_extract(d.value,'$.outer_index') AS outer_index,json_extract(d.value,'$.event_context.inner_order') AS event_inner_order,json_extract(d.value,'$.event_context.stack_height') AS event_stack_height,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.instruction.sha256') AS instruction_sha256,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.event_context.event_sha256') AS event_sha256,json_extract(d.value,'$.proof_gaps') AS proof_gaps,json_extract_string(d.value,'$.source_evidence_sha256') AS source_evidence_sha256 FROM projected b,json_each(b.diagnoses) d ORDER BY b.record_ordinal,CAST(d.key AS BIGINT)
buy_source_versions: WITH projected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT slot,transaction_index,record_ordinal,json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_buy_variant_analysis') AS diagnoses FROM bronze), diagnoses AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT b.slot,b.transaction_index,b.record_ordinal,CAST(d.key AS BIGINT) AS diagnostic_order,json_extract(d.value,'$.source_comparisons') AS comparisons FROM projected b,json_each(b.diagnoses) d) SELECT b.slot,b.transaction_index,json_extract(c.value,'$.identity') AS source_identity,json_extract_string(c.value,'$.evidence_status') AS source_evidence_status,json_extract(c.value,'$.instruction_bytes') AS instruction_bytes,json_extract(c.value,'$.args_layout_match') AS arguments_layout_match,json_extract(c.value,'$.account_count') AS source_account_count,json_extract(c.value,'$.full_observation_profile_match') AS full_observation_profile_match,json_extract_string(c.value,'$.reason') AS reason FROM diagnoses b,json_each(b.comparisons) c ORDER BY b.record_ordinal,b.diagnostic_order,CAST(c.key AS BIGINT)
supported_sides: SELECT COUNT(*) AS facts,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_buy IS TRUE) AS buy_facts,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_buy IS FALSE) AS sell_facts,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_buy IS NULL) AS unknown_side_facts,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_status='ERROR') AS failed_transaction_facts,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mint IS NULL) AS unknown_mint_facts,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE token_amount_raw_u64 IS NULL) AS unknown_raw_token_facts,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE slot IS NULL OR transaction_index IS NULL OR outer_index IS NULL OR event_inner_order IS NULL) AS incomplete_order_facts,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE timestamp_raw_i64 IS NULL) AS unavailable_event_timestamp_facts FROM silver
mint_side_inventory: SELECT mint,COUNT(*) AS facts,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_buy IS TRUE) AS buy_facts,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_buy IS FALSE) AS sell_facts,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_buy IS NULL) AS unknown_side_facts,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE token_amount_raw_u64 IS NULL) AS unknown_raw_token_facts,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE slot IS NULL OR transaction_index IS NULL OR outer_index IS NULL OR event_inner_order IS NULL) AS incomplete_order_facts,MIN(slot) AS first_selected_slot,MAX(slot) AS last_selected_slot FROM silver GROUP BY mint ORDER BY mint NULLS FIRST
buy_sell_ordered_facts: SELECT slot,transaction_index,outer_index,instruction_inner_order,event_inner_order,CASE WHEN is_buy IS TRUE THEN 'BUY' WHEN is_buy IS FALSE THEN 'SELL' ELSE 'UNAVAILABLE' END AS recorded_side,mint,token_amount_raw_u64,sol_amount_raw_u64,timestamp_raw_i64,transaction_status,quote_mint_identity,quote_decimals,base_decimals,observed_at,actionable_at,execution_opportunity_at,name,ticker,launch_at,candidate_id,source_evidence_sha256,raw_sha256,record_sha256,bronze_record_sha256 FROM silver ORDER BY slot,transaction_index,outer_index,instruction_inner_order NULLS FIRST,event_inner_order,record_ordinal
